observation_indicators.observable_en: For Tsaang gubat, match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naghuhula ng halaman, nagtatakda ng dose o nagpapalit ng niresetang gamot.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Guesses identity, prescribes a dose or replaces treatment.

levels.kaya_na_en: Correctly identifies Tsaang gubat, Carmona retusa, leaves, use and referral without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang pagkakakilanlan ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa limitasyon o referral.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Identifies the plant but needs a prompt about limits or referral.
